author: ryealhenn
quote: In my opinion, GTA 6 is not a very good game. It is too expensive, and people have waited a long time for it. The game can be boring after playing for many hours. I also think there is too much violence and bad language. The story may be interesting, but it is not for everyone. The graphics are amazing, but good graphics cannot make a game perfect. Overall, I think GTA 6 is overrated. And its full of bugs
